# Monogram

Neutral round letter avatar (SF Rounded), TaskId in SF Mono, and Chip.

`OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.Monogram` · 08 Core

## Notes

Round letter avatar for channels and roles (web/src Avatar), SF Pro Rounded, neutral surface — no per-channel hue. Pass `code` for two letters or `name` for the first letter; `icon` for Conductor (target) etc.
